title: A practical guide to coffee roasting
excerpt: Simple, honest advice to get started with coffee roasting.
paragraphs: Getting started with coffee roasting does not require expensive equipment. A few reliable tools, some patience and a clear routine are enough to see real progress within a few weeks.
The most common mistake beginners make with coffee roasting is trying to change everything at once. Change one variable at a time, write down what you did, and compare the results honestly.

Once the basics of coffee roasting feel natural, you can start experimenting. This is where the activity becomes personal, and where you will find your own style and preferences.
